scenario.summary: A threat actor used SEO poisoning on Bing to deliver trojanized IT management installers, leading to Bumblebee and AdaptixC2 infections. The intrusion escalated to a full network compromise where the actor performed credential dumping, established persistent remote access via RustDesk, exfiltrated data, and ultimately deployed Akira ransomware.

hunt.name: Bumblebee discovery and domain credential harvesting
hunt.description: This hunt focuses on the critical escalation phase of an Akira ransomware intrusion. After gaining access via Bumblebee, threat actors typically perform noisy network discovery and create 'backup' themed administrator accounts to maintain access and dump credentials. We look for a sequence of built-in utility executions (nltest, net, whoami) followed by the use of wbadmin to backup the Active Directory database (NTDS.dit) and the use of comsvcs.dll to dump LSASS memory. The hunt also monitors for reverse SSH tunnels used for persistent re-entry and stack-counts the parents of discovery tools to isolate AdaptixC2 beacons.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, process_cmd_line, parent_process_name, time FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (LOWER(process_cmd_line) LIKE '%/dclist:%' OR LOWER(process_cmd_line) LIKE '%domain admins%' OR LOWER(process_cmd_line) LIKE '%/groups%' OR LOWER(process_cmd_line) LIKE '%/add /dom%' OR LOWER(process_cmd_line) LIKE '%backup_ea%' OR LOWER(process_cmd_line) LIKE '%backup_da%') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Identify hosts running domain discovery tools or creating service-style admin accounts (e.g. backup_EA).
config.expected_signal: Processes like nltest.exe, net.exe, or whoami.exe being run with discovery flags, or net user commands creating 'backup_' accounts. Silence means no such commands were captured.

config.content: SELECT parent_process_name, COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) AS hosts, COUNT(*) AS execs, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_process_activity WHERE instr(',' || '{{discovery_binaries}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(process_name) || ',') > 0 AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY parent_process_name HAVING hosts <= 3 ORDER BY hosts ASC
